## Description

Trains a Deep Q-Network agent to optimally liquidate a large asset position across a fixed execution window, balancing market impact penalty against inventory variance risk.

## Where it may fit

Large institutional order execution, illiquid asset unwinding, portfolio rebalancing.

## Vehicles

Agency execution desks, institutional asset managers, multi-strategy hedge funds.

## Required data

Order book depth, historical intraday volume profiles, bid-ask spreads, trade impact parameters.

## Caveats

Requires simulation environment (e.g., OpenAI Gym compliant) matching real execution order book mechanics; vulnerable to execution slippage if market regime shifts.
